lines.t: Blessed, all the ones who made it out
Called your name with no more doubt
Hearts laid down, truth in their cry
Left it all just to follow the light
No turning back, no holding on
Everything they were is gone
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Blessed escape, they found the way
Caught on your name, didn't stray
Prayed, gave up the world, chose what is true
Now I bury what is life in you
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
Mmm, mmm, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
Oh
Sincere voices in the night
Reaching out for what is right
All they had, they let it fall
Just to answer to the call
No disguise, no in-between
Only truth is what it means
Blessed escape, they found a way
Call on your name
Didn't stray
Gave up the world
Chose what's true
Now there is water
Slides in you
They found the way
They found the truth
They found the truth
They gave it all
And now they live in you
We'll be right back.
